name: Native deployment supported by coordinated expression or molecular response
description: Assess bounded native deployment from measured availability or coordinated response in the same actual condition/state, preserving reporter, abundance and response limits.

support.proposition: Measured availability or coordinated molecular response of the target and proposed process in the same native condition, cell state or phase supports their compatibility for participation at that condition.

State the bounded availability/co-response proposition. A coordinated measured change can strengthen compatibility for participation; decoupling or unaffected targets narrows that proposition. Induction alone does_not_discriminate catalytic action, flux, direct substrate or causal order. observed_extent applies only to actual measured input/source geometry, clipped to original material; target_footprint can restrict that measurement. direct applies only when actual source subjects and the target proposition/conditions match. qualifications: A pooled abundance, expression reporter or phosphosite change is not a direct catalytic substrate or flux measurement. Sampling times, population composition and direct versus proxy readouts remain explicit. Selective responses constrain broad regulatory claims and do not automatically establish an entire process.

Retain actual source_ref, source_subject_refs, condition_refs and assumption_refs. The published examples below are instruction provenance about their named subjects; they are not observations of ybhP/b0790 and were not repeated to prepare this draft.

At construction and in decision context, resolve these observation kinds through annotation_support_routes for the actual caller-bound annotation policy; an entry does not supply universal component labels, select a projector, mask another kind, change a weight, or create a target finding. An unavailable route declaration remains unavailable.

Use actual retained assessments in a compatible annotation account. Selecting this entry earns nothing. The current caller-owned applicability × relation × extent arithmetic, same-component maximum, coherent-account integration and derived discrimination remain unchanged for this review basis. A finding qualification is not an automatic numeric discount; no independence, confidence or new score dimension is implied.
support.boundary: This is a concrete review candidate, with support thresholds and entry suitability still unresolved. No coexpression significance, phosphorylation-target rule, transcriptomics pipeline or universal minimum effect is adopted. The episode must distinguish compatibility for deployment from demonstrated native contribution; the current policy supplies no separate expression/deployment reliability operand.

evidence.observation: Cell-cycle induction and shrinking midcell structures connect the operon to division.
evidence.limit: Both original full primary reports read at Results level; failed mutant interpretations in the PNAS study retained as a limit. Two papers count as one system case. | Group source-use limits: The original observation is a composite of two primary reports and two Sulfolobus species. The selected URL/excerpt identifies the relevant clause; these are one grouped system case, not independent target annotations. Failed mutant interpretations remain limits; homology does not transfer an endosomal function. | This row selects an exact clause from the aggregate retained observation; other source clauses are not attributed to this URL.

evidence.observation: DolP co-purifies with membrane-assembled BamA and redistributes from midcell under stress.
evidence.limit: Full Results, selected controls and published peer-review limitations inspected; no new phenotyping. | Group source-use limits: Co-purification is not direct binding or catalysis; genetics, purification and imaging are connected results in one study. | This row selects an exact clause from the aggregate retained observation; other source clauses are not attributed to this URL.

evidence.observation: UgtP amount and localization depend on nutrients/UDP-glucose pathway state. Mutants alter cell length. Purified UgtP inhibits FtsZ assembly, while localization changes are separable from gross protein abundance.
evidence.limit: Full Results on nutritional dependence, pathway controls and FtsZ assays inspected. | Group source-use limits: Cellular perturbations and purified FtsZ assays are connected study outputs, not independent proofs of every causal link. Native sensing remains bounded.

evidence.observation: dinR loss induces the neighboring yneA-yneB-ynzC operon. Deleting that operon suppresses filamentation; inducible YneA alone reinduces elongation, whereas YneB or YnzC do not. Operon deletion reduces mitomycin-C-induced elongation.
evidence.limit: Primary publisher full Results inspected, including whole-operon deletion, separate gene re-expression and negative YneB/YnzC controls. The newer 2026 FtsW mechanism paper remains an abstract-only unexamined follow-up; do not treat the 2003 FtsZ inference as current direct mechanism. | Group source-use limits: Connected 2003 controls do not establish direct FtsZ binding. The 2026 FtsW follow-up remains abstract-only and unexamined; it is not upgraded by the older primary-results coverage.

evidence.observation: B. plebeius grew on porphyran, not tested agarose/carrageenan preparations; porphyran induced the examined PUL genes. Recombinant GH16B/GH86A cleaved native and purified porphyran with diagnostic products. A neighboring GH16A was agarolytic although intact cells did not grow on agarose.
evidence.limit: Complete relevant growth/PUL induction/ICE/enzyme Results and methods overview; no human dietary intervention, historical transfer experiment or new enzymology. | Group source-use limits: One study measures induced loci, recombinant reactions and whole-cell growth. No transfer event/donor or human dietary intervention was established; negative growth retains substrate-preparation scope.

evidence.observation: Growth-phase expression/activity separated Huc from sustained-persistence Hhy.
evidence.limit: 2019 relevant full Results and culture methods; 2023 purification/kinetics/quinone Results and methods. Do not read the 2025 heterologous liposome ATP result as direct native-cell ATP quantification. | Group source-use limits: The composite original observation spans 2019 whole-cell and 2023 purified-protein scopes. The later heterologous liposome ATP result is not native ATP quantification; early/late deployment is not an unconditional survival effect. | This row selects an exact clause from the aggregate retained observation; other source clauses are not attributed to this URL.

evidence.observation: BtsT transported radiolabeled pyruvate specifically; purified proteoliposomes demonstrated proton-coupled uptake. CstA-related mutant selection and extracellular depletion established an additional route. Cold-starved cells accumulated BtsT and rapidly imported pyruvate; sensing-network mutants failed resuscitation under tested conditions.
evidence.limit: Relevant main Results/transport Methods across three papers, including alternative-transporter and resuscitation controls. Grouped as one investigation, not three cases. | Group source-use limits: Three papers form one connected investigation. No new transport fitting occurred; YhjX specificity remains unresolved. The network resuscitation phenotype is not forced into allele-linked BtsT-only A109.

evidence.observation: Anoxically enriched activity reduced vinyl chloride/DCEs, not PCE and only slowly TCE. Peptide sequencing mapped the major candidate to vcrA; transcripts occurred in VC-grown cultures. Environmental water contained vcrAB DNA.
evidence.limit: Main purification/substrate/gene-identification/transcription Results and cultivation/assay Methods. GenBank AY322364 reported; no new field dechlorination or sequence analysis. | Group source-use limits: Culture was nonaxenic and protein only partially purified; there was no knockout. Activity, identity and transcripts are connected evidence, not independent proof of unique gene causation.

evidence.observation: At controlled IscR expression, anaerobic PMS affected type-1 repression but did not reproduce apo-favored type-2 regulation. Aerobic treatment affected both promoter classes.
evidence.limit: Five primary papers’ relevant complete paths inspected as itemized in sources. One independent published-table/oligo arithmetic probe was run. No biological experiment, new regulon scan, raw-curve fit or IscR structure computation.

evidence.observation: SQ-grown cells induced the yih cluster and DHPS oxidation; native active-protein purification/peptide identification and recombinant YihU assigned SLA reductase. SQ dehydrogenase activity was undetected.
evidence.limit: 2009 relevant whole results/discussion and reaction methods; 2014 primary main results, enzyme methods and relevant extended-data legends; 2020 accepted manuscript sequence, kinetics, structure and conclusion sections inspected. Supporting spectra/kinetic fits were not reanalyzed.

evidence.observation: yeaG induction after nitrogen exhaustion precedes a sustained-starvation phenotype. Deletion changes recovery/metabolic heterogeneity and accelerates later death; wild-type complementation repairs survival. Transcript/RpoS tests connect the phenotype to stress-program execution.
evidence.limit: Full primary Results examined, including induction timing versus 72-hour-and-later survival effects. Kinase substrate mechanism remains outside demonstrated scope. | Group source-use limits: cellular_yeaG and organism_06_yeag duplicate the same 2015 study; their source identity must be shared. The 2021 workbook retains its exact original lineage. Keep the further-72h versus 24h caption inconsistency, delta-yeaH/delta-yeaGH labels and 2021 table-count/SodB-SodA inconsistencies. Missing ratios are not zero phosphorylation.
